CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4, umask 000, and a raised file-descriptor limit
common_environment.endpoint_semantics: All source, Cargo manifest, lockfile, and test changes remain in the selected endpoint commits and their implementation/test patches.

canonical_fallback_rule: Only the six CSV-only nodes with no post-hoist ref in any evaluator may fall back. The listed commits are treated as a partial order: require one minimum, one maximum, all listed commits between them, and one parent of the minimum. START is that parent and END is the maximum. Their Docker recipes reference unavailable generated helper files and were never materialized as evaluator SIFs, so no unobserved Docker mutation is invented.
